column1: # Game profile of Tetris Effect: Connected (Switch, 2.0.2.2 = v1310720). Single player playable on the Mac; multiplayer screen input is open
# Unreal Engine 4.26 / 4.27 (FMallocBinned3) with Wwise, SDK 13.3.2; subsdk0 is NintendoSDK_movie.
# main imports EOS_* functions (from nro/EOSSDK-Switch-Shipping.nro, refused by the host). A stub in patches.py guards main+0xb64b8c against null from IOnlineSubsystem::Get("RedpointEOS").
# the NPDM declares 80 MB of system resource (virtual address memory) and main's nn::os::AllocateAddressRegion at main+0xd0b81c takes 62.00 GB
# nvnDeviceSetDepthMode selects near = 0; prebuilt pipeline bases must use the same vertex entry as the game
# the decoded shader code archives: the engine's global shaders and the game's material shaders
